aiOverview.text: The best career options after 12th depend on your academic stream, skills, and market demand, with top choices spanning science, commerce, arts, and government sectors. Engineering (B.Tech / B.E.): Focuses on Computer Science, AI/ML, Civil, or Mechanical fields, with starting salaries around ₹3 – ₹8 LPA (Amity Online). Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (B.Tech / BCA): High-demand tracks focusing on automation and analytics, earning ₹4 – ₹8 LPA initially (Amity Online). Medicine & Healthcare (MBBS / BDS): A 5.5-year path through NEET for clinical practice or specialist roles, starting at ₹3 – ₹6 LPA post-graduation (Amity Online). Pharmacy & Nursing (B.Pharm / B.Sc. Nursing): Stable healthcare careers focusing on drug formulation or patient care, with salaries around ₹2 – ₹5 LPA (Amity Online). Chartered Accountant (CA): A premier financial certification for accounting, taxation, and auditing, offering ₹6 – ₹9 LPA at the entry level (Amity Online). Company Secretary (CS): Governed by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) to manage corporate law and compliance, paying ₹4 – ₹7 LPA (Amity Online). BBA / Business Management: Focuses on leadership, marketing, and operations, with starting packages of ₹2.5 – ₹5 LPA (Amity Online). BCA + Finance (Fintech): Combines technology and banking applications for high-growth startup and banking roles (MIU). Law (BA LLB / BBA LLB): An integrated 5-year professional degree leading to corporate law or litigation, with corporate starting salaries at ₹5 – ₹8 LPA (Amity Online). Journalism & Mass Communication (BA / BMC): Focuses on digital media, content strategy, broadcasting, and public relations. Design & UX Research: Covers product design, fashion, or user experience (UX) design, starting around ₹3 – ₹6 LPA (Amity Online). Psychology (BA / B.Sc.): Opens doors to counseling, clinical practice, and organizational behavior roles. National Defence Academy (NDA): Entry into the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force as an officer after clearing the NDA exam, starting at ₹5.2 – ₹7 LPA (Amity Online). Bank PO / Clerk: Entry via IBPS or SBI exams for public sector banking careers (Amity Online). SSC CGL / CHSL: Central government positions like Income Tax Inspector or administrative clerks (Amity Online). aiOverview.text: The best career options after 12th depend on your stream of study and core strengths. Engineering (B.Tech / B.E.): Focuses on Computer Science, AI/ML, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering (Entry via JEE Main or state CETs). Artificial Intelligence & Data Science: Focuses on machine learning, big data, and neural networks via specialized 4-year degrees. Architecture (B.Arch): A 5-year design and structural planning program (Entry via NATA or JEE Paper 2). Defence Services (NDA): Join the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force through the National Defence Academy. Pilot Training / Merchant Navy: High-earning technical fields requiring DGCA Commercial Pilot License or B.Sc. Nautical Science. Medicine (MBBS / BDS): A 5.5-year medical or dental degree (Entry via NEET-UG). Pharmacy (B.Pharm): Focuses on drug formulation, pharmacology, and pharmaceutical sciences. Nursing & Allied Health (B.Sc. Nursing / BPT): High-demand clinical care, physiotherapy, and hospital support roles. Biotechnology & Bioinformatics: Combines biology and technology for research and healthcare innovations. Chartered Accountancy (CA): A premier finance and accounting pathway managed by ICAI. Business Administration (BBA): Leads into corporate management, operations, and future MBA programs. Company Secretary (CS) / Cost Accountant (CMA): Specializes in corporate governance, legal compliance, and cost management. Banking & Financial Analytics: Focuses on stock markets, investment banking prep, and financial data analysis. Law (BA LLB / BBA LLB): An integrated 5-year legal program (Entry via CLAT for National Law Universities). Psychology: Focuses on clinical therapy, corporate wellness, and human resources (BA/B.Sc. to MA/PhD path). Journalism & Mass Communication: Covers digital media, broadcasting, public relations, and content strategy. Design & UX/UI: Focuses on product design, fashion, or digital user experience. Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking: High-demand digital safety and network defense roles. Digital Marketing & Content Economy: Growth careers in brand strategy, performance marketing, and media creation. Explore detailed academic paths and eligibility through guides on Amity Online or program structures via Lovely Professional University.
